areaMix.note: mix: 'grass' = classic tall-grass random encounters only; 'roamer' = visible roamers only; 'both' = grass stays AND roamers walk. Default 'both' wherever the map has an encounter pool and open ground (habitat supports); interior/built maps default 'grass' behaviour is moot (no pools). The classic grass roll itself is NEVER altered by this file - WorldEngine's tall-grass path is untouched.

companionCommand.note: Cycles the companion command follow -> wait -> free.

engage.note: Ranged engagement action on the nearest roamer in range (approach play in Ranger mode; a real move / regular attack in creature mode).

swapControl.note: OWNER SLOT: the exact swap button is the owner's to pick. This is the wired default; rebinding changes this value only.

distract.note: Creature mode only: the Ranger companion DISTRACTS the nearest roamer in range - draws its attention onto himself for a few beats (aggro + contact threat move to him), harm-free, at the cost of exposure (it may snap at HIM). Owner mechanic 2026-10-29 ~21:21 CDT (ranger-defense package).

engagement.note: Chances are read inputs, tuned by bond band / habitat fit / temperament in creatureMode.ts - the numbers here are the base rates the resolver starts from.

roamers.spawnFrom: the map's own encounter pool (first slots by weight), so roamers are the same population the grass holds - one ecology, two presentations

source: Creature Mode + Dual Encounters package (~/workspace/pmd-mode/, owner orders 2026-10-29 ~20:12-20:17 CDT). Area mix and bindings are data; the battle STYLE is not data-decided - it is resolved by the decided rule in src/lib/creatureMode.ts battleStyleFor() (DORO-DESIGNED under the owner's delegation, reversible by his word). Per-encounter records may carry context/stakes for implementation; their style values are set by that rule, never left TBD.

rangerDefense.note: Ranger companion defence + health (ranger-defense package, owner ruling 2026-10-29 ~21:21 CDT). All numbers are DORO-DERIVED design parameters under the owner's 25% delegation - reversible by his word, not canon. Rules live in src/lib/rangerDefense.ts.
rangerDefense.poolDerivation: maxHp = poolBase + poolPerLeadLevel x lead creature level. Anchored to the dyad's own journey scale: createRoamer's wild scale is 20 + 2xlevel; a person who steps INTO hits sits above a wild of the band and below a trained partner.
rangerDefense.capNote: Per-hit damage cap as a fraction of max HP: one big attack takes a big chunk (the owner's words), never the whole bar; one-shots of the Ranger are story choices, not arithmetic accidents.
